title: how long do you spend in your dream worlds? what is the longest time you have spent in your dream worlds at a time before you woke up back here?

classification.question_topic: Duration/subjective time spent in dream worlds; whether others experience long-duration dreams with sleep/wake cycles inside the dream

meta.final_emotion: annoyed/irritated on waking; disoriented needing to remember waking-life context

interactions.description: Dream duration experienced as 'days upon days' and sometimes 'weeks' within the dream world.
Within the dream, the dreamer 'go[es] to sleep' and then 'wake[s] up and continue[s] on with my days' (sleep/wake cycle occurring inside the dream).

On waking in real life after long dream durations, the dreamer has to 'shake my brain like an etch a sketch to remember where i was at in my life here' and reports 'having to remember my life here again' and 'forgetting all the fine details of what i had been living through' in the dream.

extraction.extraction_notes: Post is primarily a question about subjective dream-time duration; no specific locations, entities, or spatial layout described. Emotional/phenomenological content centers on extended dream-time, nested sleep/wake cycles, and waking disorientation/annoyance.
